_readme: One record per trading day, oldest first. tools/build.py renders these into index.html. tools/post_day.py appends a day from the broker fills. inbox holds a clock-in time or journal entry given ahead of the nightly post, keyed by date.

pending.note: Day off, called in before the shift

2026-11-27.journal: Wasn't planning on trading today. Saw TSLA up 18%, or so I thought, and it reeled me in. It was 18 dollars, not 18 percent. Took a planned AMD trade with a written thesis and it didn't work out. Then threw 60 dollars at DCX as an honest fuck around trade. The setup was shit and I only did it for fun to see if it would pop on more volume. It didn't. Stop right below VWAP, stopped out for a 10 dollar loss. Two small trades, down about 26 dollars total.

days.finding: Oversized scalps, no stops, revenge trades
days.home_note: Oversized scalps on day one, no stops on the worst trades

fields:
• Oversized: one position hit 177% of the account
  • No stops on the worst trades
  • Revenge pattern: 8 trades within 30 minutes of the first loss at 4:16 AM
  • Wrong hours: 4–7 AM lost $123 on its own
Written setup card before every trade. 1% risk, 25% max position, plain stops, planning done after the close.
10 trading days of journal entries showing planned trades only.

days.finding: Swings paid $57, HPE scalps gave $36 back
days.home_note: Swings paid, then seven HPE short scalps gave most of it back

fields: Six swing positions closed, five of them green: +$56.83.

• Green day, same fault: seven HPE short scalps, five losers, −$35.56. They gave back 63% of what the swings made
  • Oversized: the first HPE short was 45% of the account, and six of the seven were over the 25% limit
  • Re-entry: after the first loss at 10:55 AM, short again inside two minutes, twice in a row
  • No HPE trade was closed by a stop order
WO-001 stays open. Same fix: written setup card first, 1% risk, 25% max position.

days.finding: 10 PM AMD shorts, added to a loser, 0 for 3
days.home_note: Three scalps, zero winners. Nearly all of it was two AMD shorts at 10 PM the night before

fields:
• Told ya it was night shift: two AMD shorts between 10:06 and 10:33 PM Tuesday lost $34.23
  • Added to a loser: short 5 shares at $400.69, added 2 more at $404.27 as it ran against me, covered all 7 for −$18.34
  • Re-entry: short again 51 seconds after taking that loss, covered nine minutes later for another −$15.89
  • Oversized: the AMD short hit 62% of the account, and all three trades were over the 25% limit
  • Commissions were $5.14, 15% of the day's loss. Overnight fills ran about a dollar an order
  • The only regular-hours trade was an order-entry mistake: a TSLA sell limit placed below the market where a sell stop was meant, so it filled on the spot. Closed 10 seconds later for −$0.07. No trade was closed by a stop order
WO-001 stays open. Same fix: written setup card first, 1% risk, 25% max position.

“I was late today. Probably after 10 AM. Partied too much last night. Felt like ass so i called in.. Again. Tried for a TSLA short position from a reversal at yesterdays close but the setup sucked. Well, there was an accidental fill. I used a limit order instead of a stop order below the current price for a short position and it auto filled. I wasn't paying attention i guess. So i just closed the position. for a $0.07 loss.”
